notruf:0: Man down! {opfer} is dead, {wo}. {durch} We need help here!
notruf:1: We just lost {opfer}, {wo}. {durch} Anyone close, move!
notruf:4: They got {opfer}, {wo}. {durch} I'm not staying here alone.
notruf:6: {opfer} just went down, {wo}. {durch} Send help, anyone!
notruf:7: Contact lost with {opfer}, {wo}. {durch} Somebody check on him, please.
notruf:8: {opfer} is dead, {wo}. {durch} I'm pulling out before it gets worse.
augenzeuge:1: Saw it with my own eyes: {opfer} went down {wo}. {durch}
augenzeuge:2: {opfer} is dead, {wo}. He was {opferbei}. {durch} I'm keeping my head down.
augenzeuge:4: I'm looking at what's left of {opfer}, {wo}. {durch} Stay sharp out there.
augenzeuge:5: Bad day for {opfer}. Dropped right in front of me, {wo}. {durch}
augenzeuge:6: Watched {opfer} fall, {wo}. He was {opferbei}. {durch} Nothing I could do.
augenzeuge:7: {opfer} is dead, {wo}. Saw the whole thing from cover. He was {opferbei}. {durch}
augenzeuge:8: I was twenty meters away when {opfer} dropped, {wo}. {durch} My hands won't stop shaking.
gehoert:0: Heard gunfire a moment ago, {wo}. Anybody want to check it out?
gehoert:1: Shots fired {wo}. Short burst, then silence. Not my business, but now you know.
gehoert:2: Somebody is shooting {wo}. Didn't sound like a warning.
gehoert:3: Gunfire {wo}. If that was one of ours, speak up.
gehoert:4: Two, maybe three shots, {wo}. Then nothing. I don't like nothing.
gehoert:5: Rifle fire {wo}. I'm staying put until it's quiet.
gehoert:6: Shots in the distance, {wo}. Then someone screaming. Then nothing.
gehoert:7: Heard a few rounds {wo}. Sounded like a pistol. Someone's in trouble.
gehoert:8: Automatic fire {wo}, a few seconds long. I'm not going to look.
leiche:0: Found {opfer}'s body, {wo}. He was {opferbei}. Happened a while ago, the mutants are already sniffing around.
leiche:1: There's a body {wo}. The PDA says {opfer}. He was {opferbei}. Nothing left to take.
leiche:2: Stumbled over {opfer}, {wo}. Cold already. He was {opferbei}.
leiche:3: Dead stalker {wo}. Name on the PDA: {opfer}. If anyone knew him - now you know.
leiche:4: {opfer} is lying {wo}. Has been for a while. He was {opferbei}. I covered him up, that's all I could do.
leiche:5: Crows led me to a body {wo}. It's {opfer}. He was {opferbei}.
leiche:6: Found {opfer} {wo}. He was {opferbei}. The rain has been at him for a while.
leiche:7: A body {wo}. The PDA still blinks: {opfer}. He was {opferbei}. Somebody should tell his people.
leiche:8: Not a pretty sight {wo}. {opfer}, {opferbei}. I took off my hat and moved on.
gefecht:0: Firefight {wo}. We're trading shots with people {taetervon}. Dead on both sides.
gefecht:1: Heavy contact {wo}! People {taetervon} hit us. We're holding, for now.
gefecht:2: It's a mess {wo}. Us against people {taetervon}. Stay clear unless you're on our side.
gefecht:3: The shooting hasn't stopped {wo}. People {taetervon} won't back off, and neither will we.
gefecht:4: Losses on both sides {wo}. Whoever sent the people {taetervon} - it wasn't worth it.
gefecht:5: Shooting match {wo} against people {taetervon}. Bodies on both sides already.
gefecht:6: We're pinned down {wo}. People {taetervon} have the better angle. Dead on both sides.
gefecht:7: Don't come {wo} unless you want a fight. People {taetervon} and us, and nobody is giving ground.
jagd:0: Put down {mutantakk}, {wo}. One less thing to worry about.
jagd:1: Got {mutantakk}, {wo}. Took more ammo than I wanted to spend.
jagd:2: Killed {mutantakk} {wo}. If you want the parts, be quick.
jagd:3: Just dropped {mutantakk}, {wo}. My hands are still shaking.
jagd:4: Scratch {mutantakk}, {wo}. There may be more where it came from.
jagd:5: Finished {mutantakk}, {wo}. My rifle is hot and my pockets are empty.
jagd:6: {mutantakk} won't bother anyone {wo} anymore. Stay careful, there are usually more.
jagd:7: Brought down {mutantakk} {wo}. Ugly business. Mind the blood trail.
antw_trauer:0: Damn. {opfer} still owed me a drink.
antw_trauer:1: Rest easy, {opfer}. The Zone takes the good ones first.
antw_trauer:2: {opfer}? I shared a fire with him last week. Hell.
antw_trauer:5: He knew the risks. We all do. Still hurts.
antw_trauer:7: Keep the channel quiet for a minute, will you. For {opfer}.
antw_trauer:8: Didn't know {opfer} well. Didn't have to.
antw_trauer:9: One more name for the wall. Rest, {opfer}.
antw_trauer:10: {opfer} always said he'd retire next spring. Everybody says that.
antw_haeme:0: One less to worry about. {opfer} was scum {opfervon}. Good riddance.
antw_haeme:1: Can I borrow a rifle to celebrate? {opfer} bit the dust. Great news.
antw_haeme:2: {opfer} is dead? Best thing I've heard all day.
antw_haeme:3: Nobody here is crying over someone {opfervon}.
antw_haeme:4: Good. Leave him for the dogs.
antw_haeme:5: That's what happens to people {opfervon} around here.
antw_haeme:6: Shame about the bullet. {opfer} wasn't worth it.
antw_haeme:8: {opfer} had it coming. People {opfervon} always do.
antw_haeme:9: Pour one out? Not for {opfer}. I'll drink it myself.
antw_haeme:10: Karma works faster in the Zone. {opfer}, you were warned.
antw_warnung:0: Noted. Better stay away from {gebiet} for a while.
antw_warnung:1: Copy. Marking that spot on my map.
antw_warnung:2: Thanks for the warning. Taking the long way round.
antw_warnung:3: Understood. Give it a day before anyone goes near that place.
antw_warnung:4: Heard. Anyone heading into {gebiet}: keep your eyes open.
antw_warnung:5: Got it. I was about to go that way. Not anymore.
antw_warnung:6: Thanks. Crossing {gebiet} off my route for now.
antw_warnung:7: Understood. I'll tell the others to avoid {gebiet}.
antw_warnung:8: Good to know. Stay low and keep your eyes open around {gebiet}.
mutanten:1: I can see {mutantakk} from here, {wo}. It hasn't noticed me yet.
mutanten:6: Tracks of {mutantakk} {wo}. Fresh. I'd stay away today.
mutanten:7: {mutant} is hunting {wo}. If you hear it, don't run - walk, quietly.
mutanten:8: Eyes open: {mutant}, {wo}. It's close to the path.
feind:0: People {taetervon} spotted {wo}. Watching them for now.
feind:1: Got eyes on a group {taetervon}, {wo}. They haven't seen me.
feind:2: Trouble {wo}: people {taetervon}, armed and not in a hurry.
feind:3: If you're one of ours: people {taetervon} are hanging around {wo}.
feind:4: Movement {wo}. People {taetervon}. I'm not picking that fight alone.
feind:5: Heads up, people {taetervon} {wo}. Looks like they're waiting for someone.
feind:6: Armed group {taetervon} {wo}. They look rested and well fed. Not a good sign.
feind:7: Keep away {wo}. People {taetervon} have set up there.
feind:8: Saw them {wo}: people {taetervon}, moving in a line. Not stragglers.
uhr_morgen:0: Morning, Zone. Coffee's burnt, boots are wet, nobody has shot at me yet. Good day so far.
uhr_morgen:1: Sun's up. Somehow so am I.
uhr_morgen:2: Fog is lifting. Time to see what the night left behind.
uhr_morgen:3: First light. Check your gear before you check your luck.
uhr_morgen:4: Early shift. The Zone never sleeps, but at least it's quiet for an hour.
uhr_morgen:5: Dew on the rifle, frost on the boots. Somebody make tea.
uhr_tag:0: Midday. If you're going to do something stupid, do it while you can still see.
uhr_tag:1: Quiet afternoon. I never trust those.
uhr_tag:2: Good light for walking. Bad light for hiding.
uhr_tag:3: Half the day gone and I've found two bolts and a wet sock. Living the dream.
uhr_tag:4: Hot work today. Drink water, but not from puddles.
uhr_tag:5: Noon already. Don't make plans, the Zone laughs at plans.
uhr_abend:0: Getting dark. If you don't have a fire by now, find one.
uhr_abend:1: Evening. Whoever is still out there: wrap it up.
uhr_abend:2: Sun's going down. The Zone wakes up when we lie down.
uhr_abend:3: Last light. Count your people, count your ammo.
uhr_abend:4: Shadows get long. Time to pick a place for the night.
uhr_abend:5: Smoke from the campfires. Smells like stew, tastes like a miracle.
uhr_nacht:0: Can't sleep. Something keeps howling out there.
uhr_nacht:1: Night watch. Nothing moves, and that's the part I don't like.
uhr_nacht:2: If you're walking at this hour, you're braver than me, or dumber.
uhr_nacht:3: Middle of the night and the detector won't shut up. Lovely.
uhr_nacht:4: Stars are out. Pretty, until something moves under them.
uhr_nacht:5: The fire's low, the watch is long. Keep talking on the channel.
emi_weg:1: Signal lost. Emission incoming - take cover.
emi_weg:2: Emergency broadcast! Readings have reached critical levels. All stalkers must seek shelter immediately. Repeat, immediately!
emi_weg:3: All stalkers, listen carefully. An emission is here. Find shelter and stay there until the all-clear.
emi_da:0: Connection restored. {zahl} stalkers on the network.
emi_da:2: The emission has passed. Communication is coming back online. {zahl} PDAs have reported in.
emi_da:3: The emission has passed. Check your equipment and report any unusual symptoms. {zahl} stalkers on the network.
emi_reaktion:0: Everybody still breathing? That one was loud.
emi_reaktion:1: I counted to a thousand in a cellar. Twice.
emi_reaktion:2: Emission's over. My head feels like a church bell.
emi_reaktion:3: Made it. The roof didn't. Looking for a new roof.
emi_reaktion:4: Whoever was caught outside: speak up if you can.
emi_reaktion:5: Sky is back to grey. Never thought I'd miss grey.
emi_reaktion:6: Anyone still alive out there? The sky just cleared.
emi_reaktion:7: What the hell was that? The forecast said we had another six hours. Something is wrong with the Zone.
emi_reaktion:8: Something has changed after that emission. My detector is giving readings I've never seen before.
emi_reaktion:9: Word is the emission moved some anomaly fields. Old maps may no longer be reliable.
emi_reaktion:10: Emission's done. I'm still here, the shelter is still here, the vodka is gone.
emi_reaktion:11: Ears still ringing. Did anyone else see the sky go red?
emi_reaktion:12: Out of the shelter at last. Count your fingers first, then your bolts.
geschwaetz:0: Anyone got spare bandages? I'll trade for canned meat, the good kind.
geschwaetz:1: Found a boot in an anomaly today. Just the one. Don't ask me where the other one is.
geschwaetz:2: If someone finds a guitar with five strings, it's mine. The sixth is a long story.
geschwaetz:3: Selling a detector, barely used. The previous owner didn't need it for long.
geschwaetz:4: Who keeps leaving empty cans at the campfire? The rats are getting brave.
geschwaetz:5: My knee says rain. My knee has been right since the second emission.
geschwaetz:6: Three days without a decent meal. I'm starting to look at the flesh differently.
geschwaetz:7: Looking for someone who can fix a rifle and keep quiet about it.
geschwaetz:8: Rumour has it someone pulled a rare artifact out of a swamp anomaly. Rumour also says he glows now.
geschwaetz:9: Don't drink from the barrels near the old pumps. Ask me how I know.
geschwaetz:10: Whoever borrowed my sleeping bag: keep it. I've seen what you did to it.
geschwaetz:11: Anyone heading north this week? Safer with two, cheaper with three.
geschwaetz:12: I've been walking for six hours and I'm back where I started. I hate this place. I love this place.
geschwaetz:13: Somebody tell the new guy that bolts are for throwing, not for collecting.
geschwaetz:14: Heard laughing behind a wall last night. There's no one living behind that wall.
geschwaetz:15: Trading vodka for ammunition. Yes, I've thought it through.
geschwaetz:16: If you see a dog that doesn't bark - walk away. Slowly.
geschwaetz:17: Lost a good knife somewhere on the road. Bone handle. Finder gets a bottle.
geschwaetz:18: The trader says prices are going up again. The trader always says that.
geschwaetz:19: My PDA keeps showing a stalker that isn't there. Anyone else?
geschwaetz:20: Tip of the day: the shortest path is the one with the most bodies on it.
geschwaetz:21: Someone was playing harmonica over the radio last night. Don't stop.
geschwaetz:22: Counted my coupons. Counted again. I should have stayed home.
geschwaetz:23: A quiet day. Write it down, nobody will believe us.
geschwaetz:24: You hear about that guy who found three artifacts in a single anomaly field? Sold them all and disappeared the same night.
geschwaetz:25: Anyone seen Mikhail lately? He used to spend every evening at the campfire. Now his PDA is switched off and nobody knows where he went.
geschwaetz:26: Listen, kid. A good detector is worth more than a fancy rifle. You can't shoot your way out of every problem in this damn place.
geschwaetz:27: Met a fellow on the road yesterday. Asked me if I knew where the sun goes at night. Didn't look drunk, either.
geschwaetz:28: Stay away from that trader near the crossroads. He sells broken detectors and calls them military surplus. Absolute bastard.
geschwaetz:29: They say there's a stalker somewhere in the Zone who's never been caught in an emission. Twenty years out here, still kicking. Sounds like bullshit to me.
geschwaetz:30: My detector keeps beeping when I'm sitting inside the bunker. Checked everything twice. There's nothing around. At least, nothing I can see.
geschwaetz:31: Hey, if you're still alive, come back to the camp. Your old friend is waiting. And bring some vodka this time.
geschwaetz:32: Listen, rookie. If you hear something moving in the bushes, don't go running towards it. The Zone has a nasty habit of making curious people disappear.
geschwaetz:33: I've been here for seven years. Seen things that would make a grown man pray. And still, every morning, I wake up and go looking for another artifact.
geschwaetz:34: Something's wrong tonight. Can't explain it. The dogs aren't barking, the wind stopped, and even the damn Geiger counter sounds different.
geschwaetz:35: Some idiot walked straight into an anomaly yesterday. Didn't even have a detector. Newcomers, I swear...
geschwaetz:36: I'm telling you, it wasn't a bloodsucker! Bloodsuckers don't leave footprints like that!
geschwaetz:37: Never trust a man who offers you twice the usual price. Either he's desperate or he knows something you don't.
geschwaetz:38: You can learn the maps, memorize the routes and buy the best gear. But the Zone doesn't care how prepared you think you are.
geschwaetz:39: Funny thing about the Zone. Sometimes you spend three days fighting for your life, and then you get an evening like this. Almost feels normal.
geschwaetz:40: Looking for a man named Viktor. He was carrying a blue backpack. His brother is offering a reward for information.
geschwaetz:41: Somebody left a radio running near the campfire all night. All we could hear was an old song and somebody whispering numbers.
geschwaetz:42: A few of us are gathering at the campfire tonight. Food and stories are welcome. No questions about where you've been.
geschwaetz:43: Word around the campfire is that somebody inside one of the big factions has been selling information to outsiders.
geschwaetz:44: Hey, brother. It's me. Found your old backpack near the farm. Don't worry, I'll bring it back when I return.
geschwaetz:45: Something has been moving around our camp every night. We hear it, but nobody ever sees anything.
geschwaetz:46: The Zone has gone quiet. No dogs, no birds, no radio chatter. I don't like it. Something is coming.
geschwaetz:47: Anyone heading towards Rostok? I've got a spare filter and could use a few medical supplies. Fair exchange.
geschwaetz:48: Remember that old warehouse in the Garbage? Three men went in last week. One came back. He hasn't said a word since.
geschwaetz:49: A backpack with personal papers and a photograph turned up by the river. If it's yours, tell me what's on the photograph.
geschwaetz:50: Anyone know a good place to dry boots? The campfire is full.
geschwaetz:51: My detector found a bolt. Just a bolt. Third time this week.
geschwaetz:52: I swear the anomaly by the old tree moved overnight.
geschwaetz:53: Trading a spare gas mask filter for two cans of beans. Not negotiable.
geschwaetz:54: Heard the new guy shoots better than he walks. We'll see.
geschwaetz:55: If you smell burnt toast near an anomaly, don't ask questions. Just leave.
geschwaetz:56: I've been mending the same jacket for three winters. It's more patch than jacket now.
geschwaetz:57: Does anyone else hear a radio playing at night, or is it just me?
geschwaetz:58: Selling a lucky coin. It's only been lucky once, but that was a big once.
geschwaetz:59: Who keeps drawing little faces on the shelter wall? They're getting better.
geschwaetz:60: Just got hit by a falling branch. The Zone has a sense of humor, I'm telling you.
geschwaetz:61: Pack light, walk slow, trust nobody who smiles too much.
geschwaetz:62: Found a pair of glasses with no lenses. Wearing them anyway. Looks serious.
geschwaetz:63: Anyone have a spare lighter? Mine drowned, and so did my mood.
geschwaetz:64: My boots leak, my hat leaks, even my coffee leaks. Welcome to the Zone.
geschwaetz:65: A good night's sleep costs more than a good rifle these days.
geschwaetz:66: Counted the stars last night. Lost count at two hundred. Slept anyway.
geschwaetz:67: That old truck by the road has been rusting there longer than I've been alive. I still check the cab every time.
geschwaetz:68: Whoever keeps humming the same song at the fire: I know the second verse. Please stop.
geschwaetz:69: A tip from an old hand: don't name your gun. It makes the funeral harder.
geschwaetz:70: Buying batteries. Paying in cans, bolts, or a decent story.
geschwaetz:71: I tried to count my luck today. Ran out of fingers on the wrong hand.
geschwaetz:72: Anyone else dream of green fields? I wake up and it's all grey again.
geschwaetz:73: The trader's dog is smarter than half the camp. Don't tell the trader.
aktivitaet:0: {zahl} of us on the move {wo}. All quiet so far.
aktivitaet:1: Our group is holding {wo}. {zahl} rifles, plenty of ammo.
aktivitaet:2: Passing through {wo}, {zahl} strong. Don't shoot, we wave back.
aktivitaet:3: Camp set up {wo}. {zahl} of us and one kettle. Could be worse.
aktivitaet:5: {zahl} of us resting {wo}. Boots off, rifles close.
aktivitaet:6: Scouting party, {zahl} strong, {wo}. Back before dark, if the Zone allows.
aktivitaet:7: {zahl} people heading out {wo}. No reports yet.
begruessung:0: Connected to the stalker network. {zahl} stalkers online.
begruessung:1: Network link established. {zahl} PDAs in range.
geruecht:0: This is station twelve. If anyone can hear me, please respond. I've been transmitting for three days. I don't think anyone is left.
geruecht:1: A familiar voice has been heard broadcasting on an abandoned frequency. Several listeners claim the speaker died years ago.
geruecht:2: Scouts entering an old settlement found every door open, every radio switched on, and no sign of its residents.
geruecht:3: A stalker reports being followed for several kilometers. Every time he turned around, the road behind him was empty.
geruecht:4: Coordinates received from an unidentified sender. The location lies in the middle of an anomaly field. No further message followed.
geruecht:5: Attention, personnel. Operation has been postponed. All units are to remain at their current positions until further instructions are received.
geruecht:6: An observation station has stopped transmitting. Its last message was a single sentence: "It's happening again."
geruecht:7: Multiple witnesses report lights moving above the treeline. No aircraft have been registered in the region.
geruecht:8: If you're hearing this, don't answer. Whatever is transmitting on this frequency isn't looking for survivors.
geruecht:9: A detector registered an artifact signature beneath a concrete structure. The structure has no underground level.
geruecht:10: An empty campsite was discovered near the river. Food still on the table. The fire had only just gone out.
geruecht:11: An unidentified voice keeps transmitting the same coordinates. They lead to an area that does not appear on any map.
geruecht:12: Warning: a distress signal reported earlier has been identified as an old recording. Do not respond to it.
geruecht:13: Every radio in an abandoned village was reportedly switched on at the same time. Nobody was there.
geruecht:14: An old radio station has started broadcasting again. The transmission consists entirely of static and distant footsteps.
geruecht:15: An old military frequency has become active again. The transmission contains a weather report dated several decades ago.
geruecht:16: A stalker claims that something has been watching his camp every night. He refuses to leave his shelter after sunset.
geruecht:17: The same three words have been transmitted on an abandoned frequency for the past six hours. The sender has not been identified.
geruecht:18: A research team found footprints leading into an abandoned building. There were no matching tracks leading out.
geruecht:19: PDA recovered. Previous owner unknown. Last recorded activity: 03:47. Last message: "They're coming back."
geruecht:20: If you're listening to this, I probably didn't make it. There's something in the tunnels. I can hear it moving between the walls.
geruecht:21: You shouldn't be here. Nobody should be here. Turn around while you still remember the way back.
geruecht:22: We found the entrance. It's exactly where the documents said it would be. But something has already been inside.
geruecht:23: I found the documents. Everything they told us was wrong. The experiment wasn't supposed to-
geruecht:24: Signal restored. Source unidentified. If you can hear this message, stay where you are. Someone is already looking for you.
geruecht:25: This is Marko. If anyone finds this recording, tell my sister I tried to get back. The road is gone. I don't know where I am.
geruecht:26: A strange transmission has been intercepted on a forgotten frequency. It contains nothing but a sequence of numbers.
geruecht:27: The signal appears for exactly thirty seconds every night. It comes from somewhere near the centre of the Zone.
geruecht:28: A signal is repeating on a dead channel: three short tones, a pause, three short tones. Nobody has answered it.
geruecht:29: A lone stalker says he heard his own voice on the radio a day before he ever spoke.
geruecht:30: Several PDAs near the old railway show a contact that disappears when you look at it.
geruecht:31: A stalker claims the anomaly field near the marsh sings at night. Always the same four notes.
geruecht:32: Someone left a note in a sealed jar by the road: "Do not dig here." The ground around it has been dug anyway.
geruecht:33: A voice on an empty frequency counts backwards from one hundred, then starts again. It never reaches zero.
geruecht:34: A survey team returned with fewer people than it left with. Nobody remembers who is missing.
geruecht:35: A detector registered a heartbeat inside a sealed concrete room. The room has no door.
geruecht:36: Reports of a campfire burning in the middle of an anomaly field. Nobody has dared to check.
geruecht:37: A frequency that plays nothing but quiet laughter has been picked up by three separate PDAs.
geruecht:38: The same bare footprint appears each morning near a camp. It always ends at the water's edge.
geruecht:39: A PDA was found with a message half written: "Don't trust the quiet part of". The rest is missing.
geruecht:40: Someone is broadcasting the sound of rain on a clear day. The rain gets louder.
geruecht:41: Hunters say the mutants avoid a certain patch of forest. Nobody knows why, and nobody goes to look.
geruecht:42: An unknown signal moves from tower to tower along the same line every night. Whoever it is, they're walking.
geruecht:43: Operators report a ghost signal that mirrors every message sent on the network, a few seconds late.
wissenschaft:0: Preliminary analysis of the recovered artifact suggests an unknown interaction between electromagnetic fields and organic material.
wissenschaft:1: We are requesting fresh mutant tissue samples. Payment on delivery. Please, no more samples in vodka bottles.
wissenschaft:2: All field researchers: recalibrate your detectors. Recent anomalies have produced inconsistent readings across several devices.
wissenschaft:3: Monitoring equipment has registered a repeating signal beneath an abandoned research facility. Its origin remains undetermined.
wissenschaft:4: Recording 17-B: subject response exceeded expectations. Further testing is postponed until replacement equipment arrives.
wissenschaft:5: Seismic sensors have detected movement beneath the surface. The readings are too irregular to identify the source.
wissenschaft:6: Station 04 has stopped transmitting data. The last readings indicate an unusual concentration of anomalous energy.
wissenschaft:7: We may have identified a connection between several previously unrelated anomaly fields. The results are not yet published.
wissenschaft:8: A classified research document has been reported missing. Anyone who finds it: do not read it. Return it.
wissenschaft:9: Volunteers wanted for a field study. Participants are paid upon returning with valid samples. Emphasis on returning.
wissenschaft:10: Electrical activity has been detected inside a research complex that has been without power for years.
wissenschaft:11: Radiation levels around a previously stable location have increased. We are checking for a connection to recent anomalies.
wissenschaft:12: Sample 22 reacted to light in a way we cannot yet explain. Requesting an independent review.
wissenschaft:13: Please stop bringing artifacts to the lab without declaring them. One of them is still humming.
wissenschaft:14: Observation: anomaly boundaries appear to shift slightly after each emission. Mapping data is being updated.
wissenschaft:15: Field note: mutant behavior changes noticeably in the hours before an emission. We are logging every case.
wissenschaft:16: Damaged detectors can be recalibrated at the lab. Bring the device, and an honest account of how it broke.
kanal_loners:0: Loners only: there's a dry cellar near the old road. Blankets inside. Leave it the way you found it.
kanal_loners:1: To our people: if a faction offers you a 'simple job', ask twice what it pays and three times what it costs.
kanal_loners:2: Free stalkers, listen: we don't have a flag, but we look out for each other. If one of us calls, you answer.
kanal_loners:3: Between us: the trader pays more if two of us show up with the same goods on different days. Do the math.
kanal_loners:4: Anyone of ours heading out today, check in before dark. I'm keeping the list.
kanal_loners:5: Loners: stay out of faction business this week. They are counting heads, and I don't want ours on the list.
kanal_loners:6: Shared stash is low on bandages. If you took some, bring some. That's the whole rule.
kanal_loners:7: A word for the free ones: nobody owes us anything out here. That's exactly why we help each other.
kanal_loners:8: Loners, a reminder: a good detector beats a good rifle. Look after both.
kanal_loners:9: To our people: don't sell your artifacts to the first buyer. Walk around, ask twice.
kanal_loners:10: Free stalkers: if you find a safe spot, tell one friend. Not ten.
kanal_loners:11: Quiet word: if a faction offers you a uniform, ask what it costs you. It always costs something.
kanal_loners:12: Loners, check on the newcomers. We were all new once, and some of us were lucky.
kanal_loners:13: Share the campfire, share the news. That's the only currency we all have.
kanal_loners:14: Nobody gives us orders and nobody guards our backs. So guard each other's.
kanal_loners:15: If you hear shooting, don't run towards it just to be brave. Count first.
kanal_loners:16: To those out alone tonight: tell somebody where you're going. Please.
kanal_loners:17: Don't carry more than you can run with. Greed is slow.
kanal_loners:18: Anyone with spare bandages, leave them where the new guys can find them.
kanal_loners:19: Whoever left a good knife at the camp: thank you. It's in use.
kanal_loners:20: Free ones, a thought: faction wars come and go. We stay. Keep your head low and your list of friends long.
kanal_loners:21: Loners only: if your PDA goes silent for a day, someone will come looking. That's the deal.
kanal_freedom:0: Freedom channel: whoever is on watch tonight - the guitar stays at the fire, not on the tower.
kanal_freedom:1: Brothers and sisters, reminder: nobody gives orders here. But if nobody carries the ammo crates, nobody shoots either.
kanal_freedom:2: Freedom only: Duty patrols have been pushing closer. Don't start anything. Don't back down either.
kanal_freedom:3: To all of ours: the Zone belongs to no one. Say it loud when someone tries to put up a fence.
kanal_freedom:4: Supply run came back in one piece. There's bread, there's smoke, and for once there's enough of both.
kanal_freedom:5: Freedom, heads up: new faces at the gate. Be friendly, be curious, and keep one hand near the rifle.
kanal_freedom:6: Whoever borrowed the scope from the armory: nobody is angry. Bring it back and we never speak of it.
kanal_freedom:7: Our people in the field: check in when you can. We worry. Yes, even about you.
kanal_freedom:8: Freedom: sing loud tonight. A loud camp is a living camp.
kanal_freedom:9: Reminder to all: freedom isn't doing what you like. It's choosing who you stand with.
kanal_freedom:10: Freedom channel: share your rations with those who have none. Nobody counts.
kanal_freedom:11: Someone is practicing guitar on watch again. Fine, just keep the volume down.
kanal_freedom:12: To our people on the outer posts: your watch ends when the next one starts. Not before.
kanal_freedom:13: Fresh faces came by asking about us. Be honest, be kind, be curious about them too.
kanal_freedom:14: Freedom doesn't mean careless. Check your gear before your next walk.
kanal_freedom:15: No flags here, no ranks. Still, listen to those who have survived longer than you.
kanal_freedom:16: Whoever painted the new slogan on the wall: nice work. The spelling needs a second look.
kanal_freedom:17: Brothers and sisters: the Zone takes the proud and the careless. Be neither.
kanal_freedom:18: Freedom, keep your eyes on the horizon, but check the ground under your boots.
kanal_freedom:19: We don't hold land, we hold each other. That's harder, and it lasts.
kanal_freedom:20: If you're out on your own tonight, check in. We'll leave a fire lit.
kanal_freedom:21: Nobody here is an owner, nobody is a servant. Remember that when you divide the bread.
kanal_duty:0: Duty, attention: all patrols report to their sector posts on schedule. Late reports will be logged.
kanal_duty:1: Internal: artifact finds are to be handed in, not sold. This is not a suggestion.
kanal_duty:2: To all members: Freedom is testing our lines again. Hold your positions. No one fires first.
kanal_duty:3: Duty channel: weapons inspection tomorrow at first light. A dirty rifle is a dead comrade.
kanal_duty:4: Reminder from command: we are here to contain the Zone, not to get rich in it.
kanal_duty:5: Sector report: quiet. Stay sharp anyway. Quiet is how it starts.
kanal_duty:6: Internal: any member seen drinking on watch answers to me personally.
kanal_duty:7: Duty: mutant activity is up. Pair up, count your rounds, and bring everyone home.
kanal_duty:8: Duty: discipline is what keeps us alive. Report on time, rest on time, eat on time.
kanal_duty:9: To all members: clean weapons, clean records, clear conscience.
kanal_duty:10: Sector patrols, report any anomaly movement immediately. Do not investigate alone.
kanal_duty:11: Reminder: a Duty member does not abandon his post because he is bored.
kanal_duty:12: Command notes: morale is steady. Keep it that way, and don't gossip about the rest.
kanal_duty:13: Internal: equipment losses are to be reported, not hidden. Everyone loses something.
kanal_duty:14: Duty: new recruits are to be paired with veterans. No exceptions.
kanal_duty:15: Attention: night watch is doubled when the sky looks wrong. Learn to read it.
kanal_duty:16: Members, we protect those who cannot protect themselves. That is the oath.
kanal_duty:17: Whoever finds a dangerous artifact: seal it, mark it, report it. Don't be curious.
kanal_duty:18: Every patrol returns with every man. That is the only measure that matters.
kanal_duty:19: Internal: if you have doubts, bring them to your commander, not to the campfire.
kanal_duty:20: Reminder: courtesy costs nothing. Treat outsiders with respect, even when they don't return it.
kanal_duty:21: Duty: the Zone does not forgive carelessness. Check twice, shoot once.
kanal_bandits:0: Listen up, lads: the boss wants his cut by tonight. Whoever comes up short explains it to him. In person.
kanal_bandits:1: Ours only: fat stalkers on the road lately. Don't scare them all off at once, we want them to come back.
kanal_bandits:2: Whoever took the last sausage from the pot is a dead man. I'm not joking. I counted them.
kanal_bandits:3: Lads, word from the top: no shooting near the camp. Bodies bring dogs, dogs bring trouble.
kanal_bandits:4: Between us: the uniforms have been sniffing around. Keep your mouths shut and your masks on.
kanal_bandits:5: If anyone asks, we were all here last night. All of us. Playing cards.
kanal_bandits:6: Good haul this week. Drinks are on the boss. Don't get used to it.
kanal_bandits:7: New guy lost his knife, his boots and his dignity at cards. Somebody lend him boots.
kanal_bandits:8: Lads, today's rule: don't shoot the ones who pay. Shoot the ones who don't.
kanal_bandits:9: Whoever is passing off fake artifacts: do it somewhere else. It's bad for business.
kanal_bandits:10: Keep your masks on and your mouths shut. That's the whole manual.
kanal_bandits:11: Boss says: loud isn't smart. Smart is when they thank you for the toll.
kanal_bandits:12: Somebody keeps stealing socks from the camp. This is worse than any raid.
kanal_bandits:13: If a stranger smiles too much, check his pockets. If he smiles too little, check his gun.
kanal_bandits:14: Lads, drink tonight, work tomorrow. Anyone sick at dawn takes the night shift.
kanal_bandits:15: Remember: we aren't heroes, we aren't villains. We're just hungry.
kanal_bandits:16: New rule: no bets on who dies next. It's tempting, and it's bad luck.
kanal_bandits:17: Don't gamble away your own boots. We have seen what that leads to.
kanal_bandits:18: Boss wants clean weapons and clean stories. Make sure both match.
kanal_bandits:19: If you go out, take a friend. Nobody wants to carry you back alone.
kanal_bandits:20: We don't trust the uniforms and the uniforms don't trust us. Fair trade.
kanal_bandits:21: Keep the dogs fed, keep the fire warm, keep your debts short.
kanal_ward:0: Ward, all units: checkpoint logs are due at the end of your shift. Complete logs. Readable logs.
kanal_ward:1: Internal notice: stalkers without papers are to be turned back politely. The first time.
kanal_ward:2: To all Ward personnel: we keep order so the rest of the world can sleep. Remember that on a long watch.
kanal_ward:3: Ward channel: Spark sympathisers have been seen near our posts. Observe and report. No heroics.
kanal_ward:4: Supply notice: filters are rationed until the next delivery. One per man. Sign for it.
kanal_ward:5: Reminder: confiscated artifacts go into the sealed container, not into your pocket. We check both.
kanal_ward:6: All units: stay alert. The Zone is quiet when it is thinking.
kanal_ward:7: Internal: good work this week. Command noticed. Do not expect it to say so again.
kanal_ward:8: Ward: records are clear, orders are clear, and so should your conscience be. Mostly.
kanal_ward:9: Reminder: every report is read. Every careless report is remembered.
kanal_ward:10: To all units: courtesy at the checkpoint. We are the face of order here.
kanal_ward:11: Internal: if you can't explain it in two lines, it isn't a report yet.
kanal_ward:12: Ward channel: ammunition and filters are counted at shift change. Count them yourself first.
kanal_ward:13: A calm patrol is a good patrol. Raise your voice only when you have to.
kanal_ward:14: Command advice: sleep when you can. A tired guard is a risk to everyone.
kanal_ward:15: Attention: keep your boots clean. Details matter, even out here.
kanal_ward:16: Ward: we keep the line so others can sleep. Be proud of that, and be tired of it.
kanal_ward:17: Internal: personal grudges stay in the barracks. At the post, we are one unit.
kanal_ward:18: Whoever left the gate unlatched: it was noticed, and it will be remembered.
kanal_ward:19: Reminder: a polite refusal ends more arguments than a loud one.
kanal_ward:20: To new members: ask questions. A silent guard becomes a dead guard.
kanal_ward:21: Ward: order isn't popular. It's necessary. Remember that when they glare.
kanal_spark:0: Spark, friends: the Zone is not a wound to be closed. Remember why we came.
kanal_spark:1: To our people: the Ward tightened its checkpoints again. Travel light and travel at night.
kanal_spark:2: Spark channel: anyone bringing in new readings, bring them to the lab first. The fire can wait.
kanal_spark:3: Friends, we lost good people this month. We carry on because they would have.
kanal_spark:4: Internal: share what you find. A secret kept from your own people is a gift to the Ward.
kanal_spark:5: Spark: newcomers are asking to join. Talk to them. Listen more than you talk.
kanal_spark:6: To everyone out in the field: the Zone gives to those who are patient. Be patient. And be careful.
kanal_spark:7: Reminder: our stashes are for all of us. Take what you need, write down what you took.
kanal_spark:8: Spark: curiosity is our compass. Don't lose it to fear.
kanal_spark:9: To our researchers: write down everything, even what you can't explain. Especially that.
kanal_spark:10: Friends, the Zone is not an enemy. It is a question we haven't finished asking.
kanal_spark:11: Spark channel: bring unusual samples to the lab, not to the market.
kanal_spark:12: If something glows, hums or smells of ozone: measure it, don't taste it.
kanal_spark:13: Reminder: every stalker who comes home is a data point we are glad to keep.
kanal_spark:14: Internal: share your notes. A lonely discovery is just a rumor.
kanal_spark:15: To anyone doubting our work: come and watch it first, then judge.
kanal_spark:16: Spark: we ask for patience from others and offer it in return. Remember that at the gate.
kanal_spark:17: Please label your samples. Last week we met a jar that wouldn't say what it was.
kanal_spark:18: The Zone teaches those who listen. Spark, keep listening.
kanal_spark:19: Friends, tired is fine, careless is not. Rest before you walk.
kanal_spark:20: Whoever left a detector humming on the lab table: it's still humming. We're afraid to touch it.
kanal_spark:21: We don't want to conquer the Zone. We want to understand it, and then leave it alone.
kanal_corps:0: Corps, all squads: gear check before you move out. I will not write another letter this week.
kanal_corps:1: Internal: we hold what we are told to hold. Questions go up the chain, not onto this channel.
kanal_corps:2: To all Corps members: ammunition count is short. Fire discipline. Every round has a name on it.
kanal_corps:3: Corps channel: night rotation is posted. If you are on it, sleep now.
kanal_corps:4: Squad leaders: report your wounded honestly. Pride does not stop bleeding.
kanal_corps:5: Internal: the stalkers call us arrogant. Let them. We are still here in the morning.
kanal_corps:6: Corps: contact is expected. Stay with your squad. Nobody plays hero, nobody gets left.
kanal_corps:7: All squads: well done on the last operation. Clean your weapons. Then eat.
kanal_corps:8: Corps: discipline in the field, honesty at the base.
kanal_corps:9: Squad leaders: count your people twice before you move and once after.
kanal_corps:10: To all members: gear is checked, orders are repeated, doubts are said aloud.
kanal_corps:11: Internal: do not argue orders in front of outsiders. Argue them in the briefing.
kanal_corps:12: Corps: a clean position is a safe position. Tidy up before you leave.
kanal_corps:13: Reminder: radio silence isn't a suggestion. Use hand signals.
kanal_corps:14: Squad channel: report contact first, opinions later.
kanal_corps:15: The Zone doesn't care about rank. The squad does. Stay with it.
kanal_corps:16: To all: respect the wounded and the new. Both carry more than they show.
kanal_corps:17: Internal: we are not here for glory. We are here to do the job and go home.
kanal_corps:18: Corps: before every patrol, name your exit. After every patrol, name your losses.
kanal_corps:19: Squad leaders, don't wait for perfect information. Wait for enough.
kanal_corps:20: Reminder: our uniform means something. Wear it like you know that.
kanal_corps:21: Corps: a quiet night is earned, not given. Keep the watch.
wetter_klar:0: Clear sky for once. Good day to cover ground - and to be seen from far away.
wetter_klar:1: Sun's out. Even the anomalies look almost pretty in this light. Almost.
wetter_klar:2: Dry weather. Enjoy it while it lasts, it never lasts.
wetter_klar:3: Cloudless and cold at the edges. Perfect day for a long walk, if you don't mind being a target.
wetter_wolken:0: Clouds rolling in. Could be rain, could be nothing. The Zone doesn't share its plans.
wetter_wolken:1: Grey sky again. Feels like home.
wetter_wolken:2: Overcast. At least nobody gets the sun in his eyes when it matters.
wetter_wolken:3: Low clouds sitting on the hills. The air tastes of metal.
wetter_nebel:0: Fog so thick I lost a path I've walked a hundred times. Take it slow out there.
wetter_nebel:1: Can't see twenty meters. If you hear something breathing, it's too late to run.
wetter_nebel:2: Fog rolled in. Throw your bolts twice today.
wetter_nebel:3: Visibility is gone. I'm sitting this one out by the fire.
wetter_nebel:4: Mist in the hollows. Everything sounds closer than it is.
wetter_wind:0: Wind's picking up. Something is carrying a smell from the swamps I don't like.
wetter_wind:1: Storm wind. Hold on to your hats and your detectors.
wetter_wind:2: That wind is tearing the sheet metal off the roofs. Stay away from old buildings.
wetter_wind:3: Wind from the north, cold and dry. Wrap up, it finds every gap.
wetter_regen:0: Raining again. My boots have been wet since spring.
wetter_regen:1: Rain's coming down hard. Good cover for moving, bad for hearing what moves with you.
wetter_regen:2: Everything's soaked. If anyone has dry matches, I'm paying well.
wetter_regen:3: Rain. The electro anomalies love it. Keep your distance.
wetter_regen:4: Fine rain, the kind that gets in everywhere. Gear stays wet, tempers don't.
wetter_gewitter:0: Thunderstorm overhead. I can't tell the lightning from the anomalies anymore.
wetter_gewitter:1: That thunder is rattling my teeth. Stay off the high ground.
wetter_gewitter:2: Lightning hit something big to the north. Still burning.
wetter_gewitter:3: Storm's right on top of us. Detectors are going crazy.
wetter_gewitter:4: Thunder rolling in from the west. If you're on open ground, find a ditch.
wetter_vorboten:0: No wind, no birds, pressure climbing. Experienced stalkers know what this usually means.
wetter_vorboten:1: It's too calm. I've felt this before. Find a roof, a thick one.
wetter_vorboten:2: Sky looks wrong. If you're far from shelter, start walking now.
wetter_vorboten:3: My head is humming and the dogs have gone quiet. Emission weather. Get underground.
wetter_vorboten:4: The air is heavy, the birds have gone, the dogs are restless. Check where the nearest cellar is.
dlfr_krieg:0: War: {fra} against {frb}. Open fighting has started.
dlfr_krieg:1: Open war between people {fravon} and people {frbvon}. Stay out of their way.
dlfr_krieg:2: {fra} and {frb} are at war now. Expect shooting wherever they meet.
dlfr_krieg:3: It has begun: people {fravon} and people {frbvon} are shooting at each other on sight.
dlfr_krieg:4: Alert: {fra} against {frb}. No more talking, only rifles.
dlfr_krieg:5: The quarrel between {fra} and {frb} has turned into a war. Avoid their patrols.
dlfr_krieg:6: War declared: {fra} versus {frb}. Neutrals, keep your heads down.
dlfr_waffenstillstand:0: Ceasefire: {fra} and {frb} have put down their rifles. For now.
dlfr_waffenstillstand:1: People {fravon} and people {frbvon} have agreed to stop shooting. Let's see how long that lasts.
dlfr_waffenstillstand:2: {fra} and {frb} are holding their fire. A fragile truce.
dlfr_waffenstillstand:3: The shooting between {fra} and {frb} has stopped. Both sides say it was their decision.
dlfr_waffenstillstand:4: Truce: {fra} and {frb}. The roads are a little safer today.
dlfr_waffenstillstand:5: Word is that {fra} and {frb} are talking instead of shooting. Don't count on it lasting.
dlfr_waffenstillstand:6: A ceasefire between {fra} and {frb}. Everyone is watching the other side's hands.
dlfr_entspannung:0: Things are calming down between {fra} and {frb}. Not peace, but fewer rifles pointed.
dlfr_entspannung:1: Tension between {fra} and {frb} is easing. Patrols are keeping their distance.
dlfr_entspannung:2: People {fravon} and people {frbvon} are talking again. Carefully.
dlfr_entspannung:3: Less hostility between {fra} and {frb} lately. Nobody trusts it yet.
dlfr_entspannung:4: {fra} and {frb}: the mood is getting better. Slowly, like everything here.
dlfr_entspannung:5: The pressure between {fra} and {frb} is dropping. Let's hope it stays that way.
dlfr_entspannung:6: Fewer incidents between {fra} and {frb} this week. Even the dogs relaxed a little.
dlfr_misstrauen:0: Tension: {fra} and {frb} are eyeing each other. One wrong word and it starts.
dlfr_misstrauen:1: Distrust is growing between people {fravon} and people {frbvon}. Watch the checkpoints.
dlfr_misstrauen:2: {fra} and {frb} are getting nervous around each other. Not a good sign.
dlfr_misstrauen:3: Something is brewing between {fra} and {frb}. Both sides are doubling their guards.
dlfr_misstrauen:4: The mood between {fra} and {frb} is turning sour. Stay out of their way.
dlfr_misstrauen:5: Trouble ahead: {fra} and {frb} have stopped greeting each other.
dlfr_misstrauen:6: Warning: relations between {fra} and {frb} are getting worse.
dlfr_buendnis:0: Alliance: {fra} and {frb} now stand together. Their enemies should think twice.
dlfr_buendnis:1: People {fravon} and people {frbvon} have joined forces. That changes things.
dlfr_buendnis:2: {fra} and {frb} are allies now. Who's next on their list?
dlfr_buendnis:3: A pact between {fra} and {frb}. Whatever they plan, it won't be small.
dlfr_buendnis:4: Word has it {fra} and {frb} are sharing campfires now. An alliance.
dlfr_buendnis:5: {fra} and {frb} have shaken hands. The Zone will feel it.
dlfr_buendnis:6: New alliance: {fra} and {frb}. Others are watching closely.
dlfr_buendnis_ende:0: The alliance between {fra} and {frb} is falling apart.
dlfr_buendnis_ende:1: People {fravon} and people {frbvon} are no longer on the same side. It cooled down fast.
dlfr_buendnis_ende:2: {fra} and {frb} have drifted apart. The old pact isn't worth much anymore.
dlfr_buendnis_ende:3: Break-up: {fra} and {frb} are going their own ways.
dlfr_buendnis_ende:4: The friendship between {fra} and {frb} is over. Both sides keep silent about why.
dlfr_buendnis_ende:5: Their alliance is cracking: {fra} and {frb} no longer share the same plans.
dlfr_buendnis_ende:6: {fra} and {frb} have ended their pact. Allies yesterday, strangers today.
dlfr_eroberung:0: People {fravon} have taken a camp from people {frbvon}. The map has changed.
dlfr_eroberung:1: People {fravon} have captured a camp {frbvon}. New owners, new rules.
dlfr_eroberung:2: A camp {frbvon} now flies the colors of {fra}. It happened fast.
dlfr_eroberung:3: People {fravon} pushed people {frbvon} out of a camp. Expect a response.
dlfr_eroberung:4: Camp lost: {frb}. Camp taken: {fra}. The Zone shifts again.
dlfr_eroberung:5: People {fravon} overran a camp {frbvon}. Not much was left of it.
dlfr_eroberung:6: Territory changes hands: a camp {frbvon} now belongs to {fra}.
dlfr_ruhe_ende:0: The ceasefire between {fra} and {frb} is over. The shooting has started again.
dlfr_ruhe_ende:1: So much for the truce: {fra} and {frb} are back at each other's throats.
dlfr_ruhe_ende:2: Peace broken: people {fravon} and people {frbvon} are fighting again.
dlfr_ruhe_ende:3: The truce between {fra} and {frb} didn't hold. As expected.
dlfr_ruhe_ende:4: {fra} and {frb} have stopped pretending. The ceasefire is dead.
dlfr_ruhe_ende:5: Back to war: {fra} and {frb}. The quiet was short.
dlfr_ruhe_ende:6: The calm between {fra} and {frb} is over. Take cover.
dlfr_reaktion_krieg:0: People {frbvon} want it that way? Let them come.
dlfr_reaktion_krieg:1: War with {frb}. Fine. We were ready anyway.
dlfr_reaktion_krieg:2: People {frbvon} started this. We'll finish it.
dlfr_reaktion_krieg:4: So it's war with {frb}. Doesn't change much, we were never friends.
dlfr_reaktion_krieg:5: Keep your heads down. People {frbvon} won't be gentle, and neither will we.
dlfr_reaktion_krieg:6: People {frbvon} are asking for it. They'll get it.
dlfr_reaktion_krieg:7: I never liked {frb}. Now I have a reason.
dlfr_reaktion_krieg:8: Tell the newcomers: stay away from {frb}. It's not their fight yet.
dlfr_reaktion_krieg:9: Well, {frb} wanted trouble. Now they have it.
dlfr_reaktion_frieden:0: Peace with {frb}? I'll believe it when I see their hands empty.
dlfr_reaktion_frieden:1: A talk with {frb}? Fine. But I'm keeping my rifle close.
dlfr_reaktion_frieden:2: A truce with {frb} is good for business. Don't get too comfortable.
dlfr_reaktion_frieden:3: If {frb} keep their word, we can sleep tonight. If not, we'll know.
dlfr_reaktion_frieden:4: People {frbvon} as friends? Strange times. Let's see how it goes.
dlfr_reaktion_frieden:5: It would be nice to walk the road without checking for {frb}.
dlfr_reaktion_frieden:6: I don't trust {frb}, but I'll take quiet over shooting.
dlfr_reaktion_frieden:7: Good. One enemy less, at least for now.
dlfr_reaktion_frieden:8: People {frbvon} smiling at us? Suspicious. But fine.
dlfr_reaktion_frieden:9: Peace with {frb} won't last forever. Enjoy it anyway.
zr_aufstieg:0: Skif just climbed to place {zahl} in the stalker ranking. Not bad for a newcomer.
zr_aufstieg:1: Did you hear? Skif is number {zahl} in the ranking now.
zr_aufstieg:2: Skif moved up to place {zahl}. Somebody is working hard.
zr_aufstieg:3: Place {zahl} in the ranking: Skif. People are starting to notice that name.
zr_aufstieg:4: Skif is on the rise. Place {zahl} now. Let's see how far Skif goes.
zr_aufstieg:5: They say Skif reached place {zahl}. Luck or skill? Probably both.
zr_aufstieg:6: Ranking news: Skif, place {zahl}. Drinks are on Skif tonight.
zr_tod:0: {zrname} is dead. Place {zahl} in the Zone's ranking, and it still wasn't enough.
zr_tod:1: We lost {zrname}, {opferfr}. Place {zahl} in the ranking. Rest easy.
zr_tod:2: {zrname}: gone. Number {zahl} on the list. Remember the name.
zr_tod:3: Even number {zahl} in the ranking can't outrun the Zone. {zrname} is dead.
zr_tod:4: {zrname}, {opferfr}, died today. Place {zahl} meant something. Respect.
zr_tod:5: Word is {zrname} is dead. Place {zahl} in the ranking. Hard to believe.
zr_tod:6: Struck from the ranking: {zrname}, place {zahl}. The Zone takes everyone in the end.
zr_tod:7: Whoever was chasing place {zahl}: it just became free. {zrname} is dead.
kanal_skif:0: Skif, if you're near the base, stop by the quartermaster.
kanal_skif:1: Skif, good work out there. Don't let it go to your head.
kanal_skif:2: Skif, you walk like a man with something to prove. Slow down.
kanal_skif:3: {fra}: Skif, check in when you get a moment. We like to know you're alive.
kanal_skif:4: Skif, eat something. A hungry stalker makes stupid decisions.
kanal_skif:5: Skif, the others are talking about you. Mostly good things. Mostly.
kanal_skif:6: Skif, your gear looks like it's been through a swamp. Clean it before it fails.
kanal_skif:7: Skif, come by the fire sometime. You owe us a story.
kanal_skif:8: {fra}: Skif, keep your head down out there. We need you in one piece.
kanal_skif:9: Skif, if you hear shooting, count the rifles before you run in.
kanal_skif:10: Skif, nice shooting lately. The old hands noticed.
kanal_skif:11: Skif, don't forget who your friends are when the Zone gets loud.
kanal_skif:12: Skif, still alive? Good. Tell us when you're not.
kanal_skif:13: {fra}: Skif, a word of advice: rest when you can. The Zone won't thank you for being tired.
spieler_unterwegs:0: Hold on, I'm on my way.
